title: bb_health: reporting honesty, the integrity battery, and the option surface

checks.name: and their statuses agree, because both are measurements
checks.detail: integrity=warn trueRate=10.0%

checks.name: and is still reproducible

checks.name: the sampled mode is still unbiased (within 2% of the true rate)
checks.detail: sampled 9.0% vs true 10.0% (a deterministic STRIDE reported 20.0% against a true 10.0% here — it aliased with the 1-in-10 pattern)

decisions.sample: covered by verify-sample-coverage.ts; this file pins everything else
decisions.stalenessMethods: integrity's Hash Drift and main freshness now use one population and one deterministic stride, so they cannot disagree by construction
decisions.absentRecord: a missing brain_index_status row prints as 'unrecorded', never as 0
decisions.census: every count in the report is a COUNT(*), never a page length

limitations: Real-index measurements were taken against this repo's own index; a re-measurement of the complete-scan wall time was blocked by concurrent machine load, so the controlled synthetic comparison is the perf evidence.
